The '''Blatant Beks''' were a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] participating in the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]] around [[3626 BBY]].

==Overview==
[[File:TheBlatantBeks.png|thumb|250px|The Beks]]
The Blatant Beks were a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] who favoured the noise and explosions in the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] track. The gang was often confused with the [[Hidden Beks]] who shared their namesake, which annoyed their leader [[Bangcap (Weequay)|Bangcap]]. Most of the Blatant Beks were obsessed with pyrotechnics, making it their signature.<ref name="Codex" />

==History==
The Blatant Beks were created by Bangcap and [[Old Morta]] at some point before the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally.<ref name="Codex" />
